Local AURA patch, 23 October 2026. Original MIT LICENSE.md retained unchanged.

stringChunksSplit retains the final character and chunk-boundary characters, respects UTF-8 byte lengths and does not split Unicode code points. Invalid chunk sizes fail explicitly.
ExtendedData.binaryData validates even-length hexadecimal before appending tags and uses127-byte/254-hex-character chunks.

Reference: Autodesk DXF Extended Data, group1000 max255bytes, group1004 max127binary bytes:
https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2025/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-A2A628B0-3699-4740-A215-C560E7242F63.htm

Regression: tests/dxf-xdata-check.mjs. Current Forma drawingDxf uses its own R12 LINE writer; repository search found no live importer of this vendor library. This patch does not enable a new runtime path or claim full CAD application interoperability.

Face.setEdgeVisible clears the invisible-edge bit when visible=true, sets it when false, and preserves other edges. Regression: tests/dxf-face-visibility-check.mjs (all16 initial masks).
Reference: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2020/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-747865D5-51F0-45F2-BEFE-9572DBC5B151.htm

AlignedDimension.offset uses a unit normal instead of the singular slope/intersection helpers. Positive offsets retain the intended below-line side for nonvertical lines (the upstream b(v) convention); exactly vertical lines use the right side. XY distance and perpendicularity are invariant under translation and endpoint reversal. Z and measured endpoints are retained. Nonfinite XY/offset and nonzero offsets from a zero-length reference fail explicitly; zero offset at a repeated point remains defined.
Regression: tests/dxf-aligned-offset-check.mjs. Legacy LinearDimension angular offset/rotation semantics remain under review and are NOT fixed or certified by this patch.
Primary upstream implementation: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dxfjs/writer/main/src/Sections/EntitiesSection/Entities/Dimension/AlignedDimension.ts

Dimension rotation="auto" leaves optional DXF group53 absent, as it is an override away from the default dimension-line orientation, not the line angle itself. Explicit numeric text rotation and LinearDimension group50 are preserved. Regression: tests/dxf-dimension-text-rotation-check.mjs (actual DXF entity serialization, both dimension types and eight line angles).
Reference: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2026/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-EDD54EAC-A339-4EBA-AEA6-EC8066505E2B.htm
This does not repair LinearDimension offset geometry or certify rendered CAD text layout.
